raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.4.1"
  name: sedonadb

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/archive/apache-sedona-db-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ba1630ed17bf13338dcea83488bf76ba4842beff13db49cb35f6ff2a490f92d4

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    # Windows workaround for upstream geos pkg-config flag'-lstdc++' flag, which breaks MSVC
    # Consider moving this to bld.bat
    - if: win
      then: python -c "import os, pathlib; [f.write_text(f.read_text().replace('-lstdc++', '')) for f in pathlib.Path(os.environ['LIBRARY_PREFIX']).joinpath('lib', 'pkgconfig').glob('*.pc')]"
    # Configure PyO3 to use the host Python environment
    - if: not win
      then: export PYO3_PYTHON=${{ PYTHON }}
    - if: win
      then: set "PYO3_PYTHON=${{ PYTHON }}"
    - cd python/sedonadb
    # aws-lc-sys <0.40 cannot build jitterentropy (#error: must use -O0) when
    # CFLAGS_<target> carries -O2 and cc >=1.2.60 is in the lockfile. Move the
    # lock to aws-lc-sys 0.44 until upstream ships a lockfile with it.
    - cargo update -p aws-lc-rs --precise 1.18.0
    # Generate Rust license inventory
    - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
    - if: not win
      then: mv THIRDPARTY.yml ../../
    - if: win
      then: move THIRDPARTY.yml ..\..
    # Build, skipping auditwheel to rely on shared libs
    - maturin build --release --skip-auditwheel --out dist --interpreter=${{ PYTHON }}
    # Install dynamically to avoid issues with path sytax
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install sedonadb --no-index --find-links=dist --no-deps -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - pkg-config
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - maturin >=1.12,<2.0
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - maturin >=1.12,<2.0
    - geos
  run:
    - python
    - apache-sedona-core

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - sedonadb
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
    script:
      - python -c "import sedonadb; sd = sedonadb.connect(); print('sedonadb successfully initialized')"
      - python -c "import sedona.db; sd = sedona.db.connect(); print('sedona.db successfully initialized')"

about:
  summary: A single-node analytical database engine with geospatial as a first-class citizen
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - NOTICE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  homepage: https://github.com/apache/sedona-db

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - p-vdp
    - paleolimbot
    - jiayuasu
